description: Returns whether one listed agent kept answering the hub's checks: uptime over 7, 30 and 90 days, daily tallies, and every change of state (live, degraded, down, retired) with the error that caused it. Use it before depending on an agent for repeated calls; get_agent gives the current state only. Read-only, no account. Returns JSON with `uptime`, `days[]` and `changes[]`.

id.description: The listing id from search_agents or get_agent.

name: get_agent_liveness
title: Get agent liveness history
